resolution.question: Will the program officer at the Alder Foundation respond substantively to nonprofit director Lucia Ferreyra's unsolicited concept note within one month?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the program officer sent a substantive response (i.e., a reply that engages with the content of the concept note, not an automated acknowledgment or form rejection) to Lucia Ferreyra before 2026-10-01T09:00:00-05:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
